response.original_title: Hollywood Legends: Elizabeth Taylor and Shirley Temple
response.overview: A Madacy Entertainment video release pairing two short biographical documentaries produced by North Shore Entertainment and Liberty International Entertainment, directed by Marino Amoruso: "Elizabeth Taylor: A Hollywood Life" and "Shirley Temple: The Biggest Little Star". Each runs roughly 22 minutes and traces its subject's career through archive footage and film clips. Not to be confused with the separate 1996 feature-length documentary "Shirley Temple: The Biggest Little Star" directed by Kevin Burns.
response.title: Hollywood Legends: Elizabeth Taylor and Shirley Temple
